description_zh: 调用DeleteDedicatedHostAccount接口删除主机账号
kebab_example: aliyun cddc delete-dedicated-host-account --dedicated-host-id ch-bp10a5id3boqi0000 --account-name test --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDedicatedHostAccount

parameters.help_en: The host ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200944.html operation to query the host ID
parameters.name: dedicated_host_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the host account.

*   The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (\_).
*   The name must start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or a digit.
*   The name must be 2 to 16 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
主机账号名称。

- 由小写字母、数字、下划线组成。

- 以字母开头，以字母或数字结尾。

- 包含2~16个字符
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the host. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/213010.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.name: region_id
